exposure: small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
antenatal suspicion of fetal growth restriction (FGR)
appropriate for gestational age (AGA) at birth
cohort: The study cohort consisted of preterm infants born between 24+0 and 32+6 weeks of gestation from 2012-2019 who were admitted to the Neonatal Unit at Mercy Hospital for Women.
finding: Small for gestational age (SGA) classification at birth, based on the Fenton chart, more reliably identified preterm neonates at risk of adverse neonatal outcomes compared to antenatal suspicion of fetal growth restriction.
